title: Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk - Wikipedia
goal: To replace the UH-1 Iroquois and meet Army requirements for a medium-lift utility helicopter with improved performance, survivability, reliability, and lower life-cycle costs.
abstract: The Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk is a four-blade, twin-engine, medium-lift military utility helicopter. It entered service in 1979 after winning the UTTAS competition against Boeing Vertol YUH-61A. Multiple variants have been developed for various users including U.S. armed forces and international customers.
rest_information: Initial requirement for UTTAS in late 1960s; four prototypes built; first YUH-60A flew on 17 October 1974; Army selected the UH-60 design; entered service in June 1979. Variants include UH-60L, UH-60M, SH-60 Seahawk, HH-60 Pave Hawk, MH-60 Jayhawk, and civilian S-70.
